entities.name: Q9LSA9 PUMPKIN
observations: Arabidopsis thaliana uridylate kinase; query sequence is an exact 339-aa sequence match (100% identity and coverage).
Catalyzes reversible phosphorylation of UMP to UDP; annotated with UMP kinase activity (GO:0033862).
Localized to plastid/chloroplast stroma; involved in plastid RNA processing, chloroplast organization, regulation of photosynthetic light reactions, and UDP biosynthesis.

entities.name: Plastid RNA processing
observations: PUMPKIN is associated with post-transcriptional processing and stabilization of multiple plastid transcripts, including group II intron-containing precursors.

entities.name: UDP biosynthesis
observations: PUMPKIN catalyzes UMP-to-UDP phosphorylation and is annotated in UDP biosynthesis (GO:0006225).

entities.name: Photosynthesis regulation
observations: PUMPKIN is annotated in regulation of photosynthesis light reactions (GO:0042548) and is required for processing of several plastid transcripts encoding photosynthetic components.
